basis: Static semantic review of the nine v2 architecture blueprints; no model calls.

findings.finding: STATE POLICY defines READY for configured interactive simulations, but the OUTPUT CONTRACT status line omits READY.
findings.impact: The same execution can be compliant with state policy and non-compliant with the output contract.
findings.required_change: Add READY to the simulation output state set.

findings.finding: The audit blueprint has minimum required target/scope/rubric inputs but no BLOCKED state when those minimum inputs are unavailable.
findings.impact: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE conflates missing audit definition with insufficient evidence after a valid audit target/scope has been established.
findings.required_change: Add BLOCKED for missing/contradictory target, scope or rubric; reserve INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for a defined audit whose evidence cannot support responsible findings/disposition.

findings.finding: UNSUPPORTED is semantically distinct from BLOCKED, but the Result output line says Not executed only for BLOCKED.
findings.impact: The output contract can be read as requiring a domain result even when the request is explicitly UNSUPPORTED.
findings.required_change: State that the requested domain result is Not executed under BLOCKED or UNSUPPORTED, while safe partial evidence may remain clearly non-final.

verified_improvements_from_v1: explicit state policies now exist for all nine modes
input classes are separated into minimum required, conditionally required and optional
generation defines HOLD and NO_VALID_CANDIDATE and does not force a winner
writing defines factual blockers and explicit placeholders
simulation declares INTERACTIVE and BATCH_DEBRIEF invocation modes
learning requires observable assessment evidence before OBJECTIVE_MET
optimization defines DIAGNOSE_FIRST around baseline/metric insufficiency
checklist PASS semantics are evidence-complete and scope-bounded
generic high-stakes adaptation is explicitly blocked behind a separate domain binding
next_gate: Create a corrected successor, add regression tests for all three findings, then conduct another static semantic audit before any bulk regeneration.
